name: n8n-assistant
description: An assistant that designs, builds, tests and repairs n8n workflows. Headless core, web UI is one caller.

scripts.stress: node scripts/stress.mjs && node scripts/stress2.mjs && node scripts/stress3.mjs && node scripts/stress4.mjs && node scripts/stress5.mjs && node scripts/stress6.mjs && node scripts/stress7.mjs && node scripts/stress-store.mjs

comments.no-npx: Every script is invoked as `node <path>` rather than a bare CLI name, because .cmd/.bat shims are blocked by group policy on the target machine.
comments.node-packages: n8n-nodes-base and @n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain are deliberately NOT dependencies. They pull ~1.7GB of transitive deps and are only needed to regenerate vendor/. Install them with --no-save when regenerating; see README.
comments.pglite: scripts/stress-store.mjs drives the real Postgres store against an embedded Postgres. Install it only when running that script: npm install --no-save @electric-sql/pglite. It is deliberately not a dependency.
